Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText: Recently purchased my Traeger 3 weeks ago. Came to my house in a large box and I assembled it with ease. Beautiful design and very elegant. I would call it the Yeti of grills. If you buy this product you’re buying the brand and not necessarily a traditional bbq grill. I paid a pretty penny for this grill and if we’re being honest I like the convenience and overall product, but it left me wanting more as if it were missing something for the price. Tech wise it’s not the most reliable. My grill has crashed twice while I’ve had it, sometimes it takes an hour to heat up. I’m not reporting it because let’s face it, I’m not moving that thing. Nor is it that deep.. I just want you to be informed about this product and if you are going to make an investment and use your grill every other day then I suggest getting something less expensive. As it is I’m scared to over work my Traeger because I still owe on it. Do I have buyers remorse, no. I knew what I was getting myself into. But if you’re an avid bbq enthusiast and your life revolves around smoking meat and grilling than look elsewhere. But if you’re not worried about spending money and don’t care about how long it lasts and don’t bbq but twice a month than this is your product.

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 575 Pellet Grill - Black
Results.ReviewText:
OK, So I bought the Traeger Pro. I was skeptical to say the least given the hefty price. 
I want to say from the get go that I have never done a brisket in my life. I've done many a slab of ribs and pulled porks but never a brisket since I'm not a big fan of brisket in the first place.
My brisket only weighed about 4 pounds. I only bought it because I have this new grill and due to COVID-19 the local grocery store had nothing else worthy of such a grill. I did my research and cooked the thing with the timer at about 5 hours with the temp probe in the meat. When it reached 195 degrees at right at 5 hours. I pulled it off the grill and let it rest for 45 minutes. I finally cut into it for a taste at the pointed end. It was terrible. Both my wife and I agreed it tasted like liver. I hate liver. I have always hated liver. I was about to throw the whole thing away when I decided to cut into it at it's widest point. It was much juicier and tender there and really not bad. The Traeger coffee rub flavor really came out well. The liver flavor seemed to be a problem with the meat itself and nothing to do with the cook. I once had prime rib at a restaurant that tasted the same way. Never knew why and still don't today. The main thing was I was amazed at the precise temperature control maintained through out the cook. My past experience is with Weber 26 inch kettle grills with either my Smokenator or my Slow & Sear. This was by far superior. I can't wait to do some ribs which is my specialty or a pork butt. I think I'm done with brisket. Never wanted it in the first place. If any one knows why some cuts of meat has a liver flavor, I'd sure like to hear about it.
I also wanted to say, with the drip pan and bucket clean up was a breeze. Pretty much just cleaned the grate. I also liked using the mobile app which was by far better than my Maverick temperature probes. 
I love the grill I can't wait until the market has some better selection of meat to complete my purchase.
Results.Title: Love the temperature control.

Results.ReviewText:
I've owned a Traeger for 4 years - love my Traeger grill. I recently decided to purchase a larger one so decided on the Pro 575. 
We brought it home and decided to fix burgers for the first test. It took 40 minutes to cook these and they were still not completely done. Tested it 3 more times and  finally figured out by putting an internal thermometer inside - the interior temp was exactly 100 degrees lower than the controller was stating. Returned the grill and they delivered another one. This grill is doing the exact same thing! Will be returning this one as well. 
Was told by a local Traeger service  that they were having issues with the Pro 575.

I am not  trying a 3rd one - I'll keep the one I have. VERY disappointed in this experience! 
Even tried trouble shooting with Tech Support thru emails - that was a total waste of time.
They basically email you back with quotes from the manual - I can read the manual myself! 

Traeger ... where has the quality and great support gone to? Fix the issues with these controllers and RTD rods .... your quality has really gone down!
Results.Title: Sooo Disappointed!!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill last week and I am very glad that I did. I’ve been grilling/smoking on a big green egg for the last six years. I have really enjoyed All the meals I’ve made on the egg. A neighbor of mine got a pellet grill for Christmas A few months ago. He was showing me all the features, and the thing that really resonated with me was the “ set it and forget it” mindset. At first I really questioned how legitimate that was. But overtime I kept seeing him smoke and grill meal after meal while he was at work, LOL. I finally joined the Traeger nation, and I have no regrets. This grill has been so easy to use. In the short time that I have owned it, I have grilled chicken wings, shrimps, baby back ribs and shrimp. It took me a few times fiddling with my Wi-Fi and having to delete and re-download the app, but after 10 minutes I was up and running. I’ve read all the negative reviews about the app and I can honestly say I haven’t had one problem. This is a fantastic grill for all levels of cooks. I can’t wait for my next grill.

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText:
I read every review I could find, weighed the pros and cons, went back and forth, sat on the fence, and refused to buy one because “I’m a charcoal guy.” Well after my Weber was broken during a move, I decided to replace it with the Traeger...
I wish I hadn’t waited so long. Everything I cook is delicious and cooked to near perfection. Instead of going out to eat on the weekends, we just try new recipes.
Hopefully others had the same questions I had that I can answer here:
-In 3 months I’ve gone through a total of 3 bags of pellets. I use the grill every single Sunday for food prep for the week. On extended weekends I’ll use it up to 3 times. I smoked a turkey and a brisket on Thanksgiving and only went through about half a bag of pellets in about 12-13 hours of smoke.
-Unless you already have some sort of rolling BBQ cart/stand, just buy the front shelf. I wish I had bought it with the original purchase. I ultimately ended up ordering one.
-So far, I’ve used hickory as the universal go to pellet. My local Home Depot only carries mesquite and hickory so I was limited in my options. I’m starting to order some of the other pellet flavors but I want to make sure I’m going to use them for multiple recipes.
-Use the probe, the “times may vary due to weather conditions” statement is very true.
-Be prepared to plan your meals a few days in advance. The wait times for marination is totally worth it.
-Make a brisket.

Hope this helps someone as indecisive as I was.
Results.Title: Just get one

Results.OriginalProductName: Pro 780 Pellet Grill - Black - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: Bought a Traeger Pro 780 on 1/10/20. Spent over $1000 for the grill, cover, and folding front shelf. Previously owned a 22 model for 2 years which was awesome. Wanted to upgrade to the latest greatest features (wifire). Used it once. 5 days into my purchase 1/15/20 the grill got a firmware update. Well now I know why I don't need a smart grill. It's been broken ever since and sitting under it's cover. Won't download certificates, won't connect to WiFi, won't connect to app. Traeger support, if you can get a return call or email, can only tell me it's with their development team now. Maybe more testing should have been done on the update. I'll be returning this grill to it's origin of purchase on Friday. It's back to charcoal for me.
